question: Should crawler-scraper/searxng notes say that the search success percentage that searx.space shows for most listed instances comes from check.searx.space, an address that the limiter passes by default (pass_searxng_org), so it does not predict what a scripted client is served?
why: On 2026-11-01 all 20 probed instances refused the scripted json query while searx.space showed 100 percent search success for 16 of them; the limiter documentation names check.searx.space in its pass list and the metadata of instances.json lists its address, but no page captured says that the percentages are measured from it, so the statement needs one more first-party source.
